facts.activity_file: testing for dead and applying earths

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of TX-8001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on TX-8001 and G-8102 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. TX-8001 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 15 October 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on TX-8001 and G-8102 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during routine operation; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
